newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Storm poised off Bangladesh coast.
newsitem.headline: Storm poised off Bangladesh coast.

text.p: A cyclonic storm in the Bay of Bengal threatening to hit Bangladesh has remained stationary 600 km (370 miles) from the coast, meteorology officials said on Monday.
"It may start racing towards the shore around noon or lose strength gradually," one official said. "All preparations to face any emergency are in place," he added.
Weather officials said on Sunday the storm might hit the shore early on Monday.
Some 25,000 police and civil volunteers were on standby along the coast for emergency evacuation and relief operations, disaster management officials said.
